cohort: 710 nulliparous women in Spain, 109 obese (BMI > 30) and 601 normoweight (BMI < 25)
finding: Obesity in nulliparous women was associated with increased pregnancy complications, cesarean section, and induced birth, but not significantly longer delivery times.
mod_finding: Obese women were more likely to have induced birth and cesarean section than normoweight women.
